verdict.rationale: Superpowers is fully open-source (skills/ directory as source of truth) and installed by cloning the GitHub repo or via a plugin marketplace, meaning the entire skill logic runs locally within the user's own agent session rather than through a vendor-hosted service — this is inherently 'self-hosted' by design. However, it still depends on a third-party AI harness/LLM (Claude, Codex, Gemini, etc.) to execute, so the 'core product' isn't a fully independent self-hostable stack. Missing for 10: explicit self-hosting/deployment documentation, confirmation of full offline/independent operation without a proprietary agent backend, and any discussion of hosting a shared/team instance.
